intro: WCTM Gurgaon and World Institute of Technology both sit in Gurgaon, and this page compares their recorded Polytechnic Course fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

WCTM Gurgaon vs World Institute of Technology is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: WCTM Gurgaon vs World Institute of Technology for Polytechnic Course: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose WCTM Gurgaon if its Polytechnic Course programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose World Institute of Technology if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.

WCTM Gurgaon lists Polytechnic Course Diploma in Civil Engineering, Polytechnic Course Electronic & Communication Engineering, Polytechnic Course Mechanical Engineering and more. World Institute of Technology lists Polytechnic Course Diploma in Civil Engineering, Polytechnic Course Mechanical Engineering.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
Our records do not hold a quotable Polytechnic Course programme fee for WCTM Gurgaon on this page. Confirm the current official fee notice before you budget.

Our records list ₹35,000 a year as total fees for World Institute of Technology's Polytechnic Course Diploma in Civil Engineering. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, WCTM Gurgaon's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹6 lakh for Polytechnic Course Mechanical Engineering. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, World Institute of Technology's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹7 lakh for Polytechnic Course Mechanical Engineering. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Gurgaon, Haryana. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: There is no universal winner in WCTM Gurgaon vs World Institute of Technology for Polytechnic Course. Use the programme list, the official fee notice and the admission test to decide.
If one side is missing a quotable fee or a recent official placement year, do not fill the gap with a guess from another course or an older batch.
